reason: The hypothesis relies on a single cited passage (E1) that reports superconductivity in a Ti-rich HEA but does not isolate or quantify the role of local lattice distortions, phonon softening, or enhanced electron–phonon coupling relative to a Nb-Ta baseline. The cited evidence therefore provides only a general existence proof, not specific support for the mechanistic premises.
premises: Increasing Ti and heavy transition metal content in non-Nb-Ta HEAs enhances electron–phonon coupling
This enhancement arises from locally distorted lattice regions
These local distortions soften selected phonon modes
Phonon softening increases the superconducting transition temperature and upper critical field
The effect is distinct from and stronger than in Nb-Ta-dominated HEAs
